Adapted as Dawn / 曙光号 for this demo: graphite/silver/ice-blue PBR livery, luminous viewport accents, subtle armor microbevels and weighted normals, centered 24-unit length and -Z-forward orientation. No endorsement implied.
requiredCreditPlacement: Keep this credit in the demo credits and distribute DAWN-ASSET-ATTRIBUTION.txt with the GLB.
modifications: Retained the complete artist-authored hull, twin bow forms, recessed structure, rear engine housings, window galleries and all four authored PBR maps.
Remapped violet armor to cool silver and neutral surfaces to graphite while retaining panel lines, weathering and material variation.
Remapped original emissive lighting to ice blue and added subtle emissive response to original blue viewport slots.
Added 0.022 source-unit two-segment, angle-limited armor microbevels, applied weighted normals and triangulation.
Baked 180-degree up-axis rotation, centered the bounds and normalized longitudinal extent to 24 units.

Repaired 18 zero-length bevel tangents, orthogonalized all 17,408 tangent frames by Gram–Schmidt against their normals with collapse fallback, preserving handedness; reencoded all four PNGs without unsupported metadata.

engineSockets.coordinateSpace: Final centered 24-unit GLB / transport local space

previewMethod: Blender 4.3.2 CPU Cycles, exact sanitized final GLB reimport, 64 samples, 1200x880, studio lighting. No image-generation or composited hull.
integration: Load the GLB as a cached host-owned Object3D and pass it as assets.dawnShip.
Candidate creates only a hierarchy clone. Do not override embedded PBR colors/maps or dispose shared resources on game exit.
Optional assets.dawnEngineLayout uses the four listed sockets, assets.dawnEngineRadius=.42.
Provider normalizes the clone to max dimension24; model is already centered and 24 units long. No additional yaw required.
Keep the transport mission root/collision radii and all route/health/target/distance calculations unchanged.
